items.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So I think we started together at Baldwin-Wallace College in Berea, Ohio, after which he had arranged for me to be at Princeton for a period.

ctx.x: How about education? You began residencies at several institutions.
Well, that was all started by Morroe Berger at Princeton, as you . . .
I think I’m somewhat familiar with him. [laughs]
